services.intro: Fixed prices, clear delivery dates. Send your assets and a reference or idea; you get a storyboard first, then a demo link to test on your own phone, then final files for every network. Missing playable UI like an end card, buttons or win/lose banners? I can make those to match your game.

items.name: New playable ad
items.body: Built from your gameplay video, assets or Unity project, so it looks and feels like your real game.
includes: No playable UI? I supply end card, buttons, win/lose banners

items.name: Network conversion
items.body: Already have a playable? I package it for each network with the right MRAID, CTA and size limit, and fix what gets rejected.

items.name: Variations for A/B tests
items.body: New levels, skins, texts, end cards or languages on top of a playable you already run.

terms.v: A simple one-mechanic playable in as little as 4 hours, when assets and reference are ready.
Changes inside the agreed scope are free.
Your unreleased game and assets stay private. Happy to sign your NDA.
Progress every day and a demo link you can test on your phone.

hero.subheadline: I turn your game's core mechanic into a 30-second playable ad, ready for every major ad network — usually in under 48 hours from the moment your assets land.

about.statement: I came to ads from making real games — so I know what makes a mechanic sticky. Today I build playables, lead the creative behind them, and design the AI workflows that let one person do the work of a team.

projects.title: Bus Away
projects.summary: Tap the cars in the right order to fill each bus before the queue piles up. A clean traffic-jam puzzle that teaches itself in the first tap.

projects.title: Water Sort
projects.summary: The classic water-sort loop with a twist: a frozen column that cracks as you sort. Two guided moves, then the player is on their own.

projects.title: Hungry Gecko
projects.summary: Feed numbered color blocks to the gecko and watch a pixel-art picture come alive. Satisfying stacking with a reveal at every step.

projects.title: Wool Block Jam
projects.summary: Swipe knitted wool blocks out through the matching colored gates. Cozy, tactile textures on a quick-to-read jam puzzle.

projects.title: Bead Fill Color Block
projects.summary: Slide coloured blocks into the board and fill a pixel-bead Pharaoh before you run out of moves. A sliding-block puzzle with a tight 15-move hook.

projects.title: Jigsaw Solitaire
projects.summary: Swap scrambled cards to rebuild a famous painting. A calm jigsaw-meets-solitaire puzzle with art-gallery visuals.

projects.title: Worm Color Blast
projects.summary: Guide cute color worms to their holes and blast away the chocolate wall above. Path-finding puzzle that reads even at thumbnail size.

projects.title: Tricky Prank
projects.summary: Help the poor lady out of a messy situation by picking the right item. A short story-driven brain teaser with a funny payoff.

projects.title: Brainrot Merge
projects.summary: Drop and merge meme characters inside a jar until they evolve into bigger ones. Physics-based merge with trending Brainrot faces.

projects.title: Sprunkie Music Box
projects.summary: Drag outfits onto Sprunkie characters to build a beat, one layer at a time. A creative music-mixing playable with a horror twist.

experience.intro: Two years in-house building a studio's playable pipeline from zero, freelance playables for studios and agencies, and my own tools and games on the side.

branches.label: In-house
branches.title: JOYBIT · Brave Holdings
branches.body: I was JOYBIT's first playable ads developer — part of Brave Holdings, one of Vietnam's largest mobile game groups. I set up playable production from zero: the workflow, the network-ready build process and the quality bar every playable after was held to. Starting from scratch never meant starting small. Those playables stood next to the big studios' work and outperformed it — and they gave JOYBIT the confidence to step into mobile puzzle, one of the toughest genres on the store.
branches.highlight: First playable hire. I built the pipeline the studio still ships on.

branches.label: Freelance
branches.title: Playables for studios & agencies
branches.body: Playable ads for mobile game studios and UA agencies: new builds from video or assets, Unity projects cut down into light playables, conversions and A/B variations. Still taking projects today.

branches.label: Fast production
branches.title: Built for speed
branches.body: Years of reusable mechanics, my own conversion tool and an automated export and QA routine. That is why a full playable usually ships in under 48 hours, and a simple one can be ready the same day.

branches.label: Own ventures
branches.title: My own tools & games
branches.meta: Products I own end to end
branches.body: Creative Dash Lab, the playable and video tool for UA teams that I use on client work. And Metal Sail, my indie studio: award-winning jam games and Unity WebGL games live on Playgama and CrazyGames.

ai.intro: Speed comes from preparation, not shortcuts. A clear brief, reusable mechanic templates and my own export tool mean your time goes into the idea and the feel, not into packaging.

ventures.title: Creative Dash Lab
ventures.body: A platform for UA teams to produce playable ads and video faster: a drag-and-drop Playable Canvas with bulk variants, one-click conversion between ad networks, asset extract-and-replace, and video resizing — all in the browser. It is the same tool I use on client projects, which is why every build ships network-ready.
